rationale.complete: Round 1 done; round 1b re-evaluation on context-ledger visibility, deterministic labels, the DQ4 work ledger and DQ6 ballots done, with a native layer (#26 per election round with read-out times; NE42 merge A-B-A). Holdout not run; the agent-level mechanism test is not started.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction (tau proportional to 1/lambda2) failed again on improved data (slope 0.38 [0.05, 0.60]; the slope-1 rule loses to a constant), and the sub-linear lead weakens under controls. Votes settle at the read-out timescale, which supports the herding-wave rival, not the lambda2 law. G 1 -> 2 (ground-truth vote instants); other axes unchanged; no holdout.
rationale.usefulness: Two calibrated base rates an operator can use: project majorities about 4.5 active h after first appearance (80%: 1-13.5 h), in attention and in work commits alike; deadline-bound votes within 2-3 read-out cycles (tens of seconds), so vote windows should be sized to read-out delays. Plus the caution that room spectral gaps mostly measure message volume.

one_line: Consensus time does not follow 1/lambda2: a constant ~4.5 h forecast wins for projects (in work too), half of consensus is kickoff-set or one-window waves, and votes settle at read-out speed
